China’s manufacturing and export success is provoking growing anxiety among its trading partners. Amid the largest trade surplus in world history — likely over $1.2 trillion this year — calls for Chinese policymakers to ‘rebalance’ the economy towards domestic demand are growing louder. With goods imports from China surging, global policymakers are considering, or have enacted, various forms of trade protection.
